event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: ITA 221986 was represented by Lorenzo GHIROTTI.
GRE 223379 was represented by Emmanouil Anastasios VOMVYLAS.
ITA 221986 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
facts: The wind was about 15 knots with choppy seas.
GRE 223379 and ITA 221986 were sailing upwind towards mark 1, both on starboard tack.
When the boats were on the starboard layline, they were overlapped, with ITA 221986 to leeward.
The lateral distance between the boats was 1.5m.
When the boats were 1m from mark 1, GRE 223379 held his course for 3 seconds and ITA 221986 bore away to round the mark.
There was no contact between the boats as they rounded the mark.
conclusions: GRE 223379 to windward kept clear of ITA 221986 to leeward and complied with RRS 11.
